protocols.name: MEMCOMPILER_FIXED_SELECTED_IDENTITY_RECEIVER_EFFECT_PAIR
protocols.rule: A claim that receiver injection versus abstention alone caused an outcome difference must use one canonical pre-effect binding that freezes implementation/compiler artifact, task/dataset, memory database and updates, retrieval/candidate pool, restorable environment state, selected memory IDs/digests, selector output and compiled guidance, executor policy/sampling and RNG state. The matched pair must contain exactly one inject and one abstain condition; the inject payload must equal the bound compiled guidance, abstain carries no memory payload, the intervention must change executor-input digest, and outcomes must be independently artifact-bound. Without these bindings, retain only the weaker fixed-candidate-pool claim.
protocols.test_result: 14/14 expected semantic outcomes; 14/14 cases structurally valid under Draft 2020-12.
protocols.scope: Protocol causal-isolation provenance only; does not establish that injecting memory improves ScienceWorld performance.
